column2: For split ring or shear plate connectors, moisture content limitations apply to a depth of 3/4" below the surface of the wood.

C_M = 0.7 for dowel-type fasteners with diameter, D, less than 1/4". C_M = 1.0 for dowel-type fastener connections with: 1) One fastener only, or 2) Two or more fasteners placed in a single row parallel to grain, or 3) Fasteners placed in two or more rows parallel to grain with separate splice plates for each row.
For Roof Sheathing Ring Shank (RSRS) and Post-Frame Ring Shank (PF) nails, C_M = 1.0.
